subtitle: Backend Developer
description: Portfolio of Danilo Lopes, backend developer focused on Node.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, and infrastructure.
heroBio: I build APIs, services, and backend systems focused on architecture, databases, service integration, and infrastructure.
aboutText:
I have been studying and developing software since 2018, with an increasing focus on backend systems in recent years.

I mainly focus on developing robust backend services and APIs — working with relational and NoSQL database modeling, authentication, service integration, WebSockets, payment gateways, and Docker infrastructure.

My progression started with curiosity and self-taught experimentation, grew into consistent public building on GitHub, and today is dedicated to software engineering best practices and solving real system problems.
trajectorySubtitle: How my way of thinking and building software evolved, from 2018 to today.
traj2018Desc: This was when I started exploring code on my own. I didn't have a defined career path yet; it was driven by curiosity and a genuine desire to understand how software works under the hood.
traj2018Takeaway: I grasped core programming logic and realized that solving problems through code was what I truly wanted to pursue.
traj2022Desc: I created my current GitHub profile and began publishing my projects consistently. From here on, I began experimenting with different tools and building complete applications.
traj2022Takeaway: I realized the power of public documentation and building end-to-end projects rather than only following tutorials.
traj2023Desc: I narrowed my focus to backend development, building event-driven services, integrations, and real-time bots with Node.js and TypeScript.
traj2023Takeaway: Dealing with asynchronous event streams taught me the vital importance of error handling and concurrency control.
traj2024Desc: I shifted to building more complete and secure APIs, working with JWT authentication, strict schema validation, relational/NoSQL modeling, and containerization with Docker and Compose.
traj2024Takeaway: I realized making an API work is straightforward; the real challenge begins when it must handle database persistence, authentication, and ongoing changes without becoming unmaintainable.
traj2025Desc: I developed full-fledged platforms integrating Pix payments with Mercado Pago webhooks, real-time WebSockets notifications, traffic quotas, and critical business logic.
traj2025Takeaway: As systems grow, separating concerns and establishing clean boundaries between modules is essential for service maintainability and reliability.
trajNowDesc: Currently, my focus is deepening software engineering fundamentals, exploring Go for high-efficiency concurrent services, and designing clean, modular backend architectures.
trajNowTakeaway: The goal isn't chasing hype, but mastering solid data modeling, decoupled business rules, and sustainable service design.
projectsDescription: Practical applications and services I've built, from architecture to deployment.
projectDesc0: Local marketplace with store catalog, orders, authentication, Pix payments, and real-time updates via WebSockets and Mercado Pago.
projectDescNox: Proxy reseller backend handling authentication, traffic monitoring, Pix payments, external provider integration, and business logic.
projectDesc1: Automated real-time package tracking WhatsApp bot built with Node.js and Baileys library, handling asynchronous event flows.
projectDesc2: REST API built with Node.js, Express, and MongoDB featuring secure JWT authentication, route validation, and frontend integration.
skillsDescription: Technologies, tools, and concepts I apply in software development.
skillBackendDesc: Building RESTful APIs, backend services, and event-driven systems with Clean Architecture, SOLID principles, and solid business logic.
skillDatabaseDesc: Relational and NoSQL modeling focused on integrity, ACID transactions, migrations, and optimized queries.
skillDevopsDesc: Environment parity with Docker & Docker Compose, version control, and deploying backend services.
skillFrontendDesc: Developing modern, responsive interfaces with Next.js and Tailwind CSS integrated with backend services.
